tokens.note: Studio-as-reference (motion-design / branding studio, like Goodpatch). Stark editorial portfolio: pure black ink (#000000) on white canvas (#ffffff), 0px-radius everywhere, no shadows. Type = neue-haas-unica (Latin) + Noto Sans TC (Traditional Chinese).
